notes.title: Congratulations To Free Game Winners and Small Update
notes.notes:
Congratulations go to the five winners of our Twitter Gurumin giveaway. Each of these fine people won a free key for posting their favorite review and including the hashtag #GuruminRocks   @MattMasterMind  @MarcusRaven86 @halvirh @tnkhangid @Johtolink #GuruminRocks

On a less fun note: some users recently reported a crash when starting Gurumin. It turns out that one of the under-the-hood improvements we made when improving gamepad support in our last update did not play well with all options in the advanced graphics settings. This caused some users to experience crashing at start. This has been fixed and we apologize deeply for the inconvenience. 

And finally, a great piece of art, because it's Friday.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/w1OiyUZ.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 3/30/15 is Gurumin Release Day!
notes.notes:
It's official! Monday, March 30, 2015 all productivity stops as Gurumin: A Monstrous Adventure hits Steam!

Stay tuned tuned for more screen shots, video and other updates!
